title: Create AgentProfile registry, schemas, and initial profile validation
verify: All product agents are registered as AgentProfile records inside one shared AgentHarness.
Profile risk_class values remain read_only, draft_only, or approval_gated.
evidence_required: Schema validation tests for AgentProfile fields, statuses, risk classes, allowed tools/context/output contracts, budget profiles, and trace policies.
Negative tests for disabled/deprecated profile run starts.
constraints: Agent-specific behavior is explicit in AgentProfile allowlists, not hidden prompts.
No profile receives UI Feed replay, raw chat as fact, hidden provider memory, unapproved governance content, secrets, or auth material.
invariants: Separate ungoverned product-agent harnesses are forbidden.
Agno configuration cannot grant authority beyond project profile and harness policy.
verification_targets: Every product agent profile has competence boundary, allowed context/tools/claims, memory scope, risk class, budget profile, trace policy, and eval refs.
